eligibility.evidence: Methods (p.2): the authors train small vanilla decoder-only Transformers from scratch on N-back sequences (1 layer, 1 head, no FFN); no pretrained generative language model is tested. Prior GPT results are only reproduced from another paper (Fig. 1b).

A.title: Self-Attention Limits Working Memory Capacity of Transformer-Based Models
A.venue: NeurIPS 2024 Workshop on Behavioral Machine Learning (arXiv v2)

G.notes: Mechanistic study of purpose-built toy Transformers; no pretrained LLM is run. Referee would ask how findings transfer to pretrained LLMs, which the authors themselves say is not straightforward (Discussion, p.5).
